changed_factor: slip from0.05 to0; same360-ray simulated sensor and frozen route
purpose: Separate drift-driven mapping error from scan sparsity and test the chain in an ideal odometry condition.
limits: Ideal odometry is simulator truth by construction. Map must still be produced by slam_toolbox; this cannot demonstrate robustness to real wheel slip or validate previous noisy results.
outcomes_to_report: final SLAM pose vs independent simulator truth
